name: TinyFins
summary:
Tiny Fins lets you swim free in an ocean playground, guiding a school of cute fish with a sweep of your hand. Dive past colorful clams, snag bunches of bubbles, and avoid hungry sharks!

Why you will love it: Super-smooth controls that make sudden sprints and quick pivots a cinch when you’re gliding through the water. They’re a lifesaver when you go from popping a string of bubbles to deftly avoiding a spiky puffer fish!

Features include:
- Shark, pufferfish and squid enemies
- Highscore system with the ab
